status: Registered after V5 primary development results, before this round historical holdout assessment
purpose: Test whether sparse physiology was hidden by raw missing hourly lags; retain explicit next-action decoding
feature_change: For each original recorded variable: causal last value, observation age, last two observation difference and slope, mean and observation count in last6h; original dose/setting variables are never jittered; all calculations only use k<h
cadence_change: Past setting-change counts and elapsed times over all available pre-origin hours, plus recorded-stock/rate proxy and past additions; not physical measured stock or urine flow
inputs: Original V4 source and static availability; no retrospective target, nursing reconciliation or future completion record used as input
training: Exactly the V5b100-iteration HGB and conditional expert budget, patient and class weights, source anchors; unchanged event thresholds
setting_selection: Same exact inner-OOF F1 maximization under source-persistence MAE+1mL/h constraint as V5c
volume_selection: Same inner OOF historical hybrid + newly fitted absolute/residual HGB mixtures as V5b
final_selection: Use all-development3fold OOF only; no historical holdout tuning
interpretation: Exploratory redevelopment, report V5c and V6 separately; clinical or online pump validation is not created by preprocessing
